newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish share index, trade volume at new records.
newsitem.headline: Turkish share index, trade volume at new records.

text.p: Istanbul shares continued their strong uptrend in active trade on Monday.
The IMKB-100 closed at a new all-time high of 83,300.96, gaining 1,557.34 points, or 1.91 percent over Friday's previous high of 81,743.62.
Trade volume also leapt to a record 28.83 trillion lira ($302.5 million) from Friday's 23.95 trillion ($252.3 million) and compared to a previous high of 26.80 trillion ($282 million) on March 4.

"The rise accelerated after the critical 80,000 barrier was pierced (on Friday). Strong volume is supporting the rise and there are no significant movements in alternative markets," said Okay Alpay from Interbank.
"Major correction may emerge at 86,000-87,000 levels because there is resistance awaited at the index's 89-90 cent levels in dollar terms," he added.
The index which currently stands at $0.87, compared to a $1 record it hit in April, has soared 28.6 percent since September 13 in the medium-term uptrend.
